name: ICEE Scream: Haunted Bubbles
author: Unity Play
description:
ICEE Scream: Haunted Bubbles is a spine-chilling bubble shooter adventure where you take on the role of the brave ICEE Bear, battling to stop the evil Raging Raccoon from unleashing a spooky curse on the frozen ICEE world. Armed with your bubble cannon, you'll journey through haunted locations, popping ghostly bubbles and solving eerie puzzles to save the day.

ICEE Scream: Haunted Bubbles is a licensed product from The ICEE Company.
